import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_1.csv"
    source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_2.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)  # Columns: ['user_id', 'year_school', 'floor']
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)  # Columns: ['user_id', 'party', 'libcon']
    df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path)  # Columns: ['user_id', 'fav_music']

    # Convert user_id columns to integer if not already
    df0['user_id'] = df0['user_id'].astype(int)
    df1['user_id'] = df1['user_id'].astype(int)
    df2['user_id'] = df2['user_id'].astype(int)

    # Merge the three dataframes on 'user_id'
    # First merge df0 and df1 (inner join to keep only user_ids present in both)
    df_01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='user_id', how='inner')

    # Then merge the result with df2 on 'user_id' (inner join)
    df_final = pd.merge(df_01, df2, on='user_id', how='inner')

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema
    # Target schema: ['user_id': integer, 'year_school': string, 'floor': string, 'party': string, 'libcon': string, 'fav_music': string]
    df_final = df_final[['user_id', 'year_school', 'floor', 'party', 'libcon', 'fav_music']]

    # Ensure data types match target schema
    df_final['user_id'] = df_final['user_id'].astype(int)
    df_final['year_school'] = df_final['year_school'].astype(str)
    df_final['floor'] = df_final['floor'].astype(str)
    df_final['party'] = df_final['party'].astype(str)
    df_final['libcon'] = df_final['libcon'].astype(str)
    df_final['fav_music'] = df_final['fav_music'].astype(str)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_final.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
